Former Kano State Governor, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, has invited Nigerians to follow him on TikTok for authentic information, latest updates and exclusive content about his daily activities.
Kwankwaso made the announcement in a post on X on Wednesday, in which he confirmed his presence on the social media platform and encouraged members of the public to connect with him.
“I encourage you all to follow me there for authentic information, the latest updates, and exclusive contents directly related to my daily life,” he said.
The former governor also expressed optimism about Nigeria’s future, declaring, “Nigeria will be OK.”
The announcement offers Kwankwaso another avenue to communicate directly with his supporters and the wider public through social media.
TikTok, a platform popular for short-form videos, has become an important channel for public figures seeking to share personal updates, reach younger audiences and engage followers.
